title: smime-tree: SigningKey::sign() receives raw DER SetOfAttributes — not documented for HSM callers
description: sign.rs:96-97 passes DER(SignedAttributes) directly to key.sign(). The doc on SigningKey::sign says 'sign data' but does not specify what 'data' is: the full DER-encoded SET OF Attribute with tag 0x31, not pre-hashed, not stripped. For HSM integrations where key.sign() is a remote call, the HSM must not add its own framing. This is especially important and must be explicitly documented in the trait doc.
